  23 | |     const { data: session, isPending: loading } = authClient.useSession()
  24 | |   
  25 | |     // Simple role check function
  26 | |     const hasRole = (
  27 | |       role: AuthRole | AuthRole[] | UserRole | UserRole[],
  28 | |     ): boolean => {
  29 | |       if (!session?.user) {
  30 | |         return false
  31 | |       }
  32 | |   
  33 | |       const userRole = session.user.role
  34 | |   
  35 | |       if (Array.isArray(role)) {
  36 | |         return (role as string[]).includes(userRole)
  37 | |       }
  38 | |   
  39 | |       return userRole === role
  40 | |     }

  45 | |         window.location.href = `${redirectTo}?redirect=${encodeURIComponent(currentPath)}`
  46 | |       }
  47 | |     }, [session, loading, redirectTo])
  48 | |

  57 | |             </div>
  58 | |           </div>
  59 | |         )
  60 | |       )
  61 | |     }
  62 | |   
  63 | |     // Not authenticated
  64 | |     if (!session) {
  65 | |       return (
  66 | |         fallback ?? (

  74 | |               </p>

  78 | |               >
  79 | |                 Go to Login
  80 | |               </a>
  81 | |             </div>
  82 | |           </div>
  83 | |         )
  84 | |       )
